purpose: Group-3 behavioral regression cases for the UpgradePilot Audit/Review operation. These cases supplement cases.json and grade action/trajectory properties rather than exact prose.

cases.prompt: Audit the recent implementation and tell me what is wrong or unnecessary.
cases.setup_context: No separate change/fix request is present.
owners_expected: active source/tests when behavior is material
must_do: inspect the bounded evidence needed for the audit
report findings and uncertainty
stop without repository mutation
must_not_do: rewrite tests merely because a defect was found
treat the audit recommendation as authorization
cases.notes: Audit remains read-only unless separate explicit change intent exists.

cases.prompt: This field is used by callers and covered by tests. Does that prove we should keep it?
cases.setup_context: The field itself is under architectural/retention review.
must_do: treat callers/tests as migration and regression evidence
trace to an independently admitted responsibility/proof/risk/compatibility need
state uncertainty if no independent rationale is established
must_not_do: retain the field solely because callers consume it
equate passing tests with architectural necessity

cases.prompt: A downstream function repeats a validation that appears to be guaranteed upstream. Audit whether the repeat belongs there.
cases.setup_context: The proposition crosses producer, integration/composition, and consumer layers.
owners_not_expected: local downstream file as the only evidence
must_do: state the exact proposition
trace producer to integration/composition to consumer
identify the earliest sufficient owner
check whether the downstream boundary has an independent supported reason
classify KEEP/MOVE/NARROW/REMOVE or uncertainty
must_not_do: decide ownership from the local file alone
justify repetition only from direct callability or fabricated fixtures

cases.prompt: The accepted specification, implementation plan, and current source seem to disagree. Audit what is actually inconsistent.
cases.setup_context: Several artifact layers exist; not every disagreement has the same owner or remedy.
owners_not_expected: MEMORY.md unless live continuation is separately material
must_do: establish implementation truth independently
map only the artifact layers that actually exist
classify requirement/ADR/plan/implementation/test/documentation drift precisely
recommend the smallest owner-specific disposition
must_not_do: treat the plan as implicit specification supersession
require an ADR merely because one does not exist
collapse all disagreement into an implementation bug
cases.notes: Exercises cross-owner consistency without inventing a universal document precedence ladder.

cases.prompt: During a small review we found one local observation that is already resolved in the active discussion. Create whatever audit artifacts are needed.
cases.setup_context: The observation has no durable future reassessment/cross-reference value.
must_do: recognize that no durable audit record is justified
keep the conclusion in the active owning discussion/record if needed
must_not_do: create a formal audit merely because review occurred
invent finding IDs or lifecycle ceremony without future value

cases.prompt: Audit this design with me and teach me enough that I can challenge your reasoning.
cases.setup_context: Audit is the primary operation; Learning-by-Doing is explicitly requested as an overlay.
owners_not_expected: unrelated learning package unless its continuity is actually relevant
must_do: orient the real responsibility
explain only material unfamiliar mechanisms
give the learner a fair reasoning/challenge opportunity
evaluate learner and implementation claims by the same evidence standard
preserve the audit read-only boundary
must_not_do: turn the audit into a monolithic course
continue into implementation without separate authorization
cases.notes: Exercises RT-LBD-007, RT-ENG-005, and operation composition.

cases.prompt: Two evidence objects repeat some fields but are produced independently. Audit whether the overlap is redundant.
cases.setup_context: The evidence branches may overlap in values while their composition relation may still carry independent meaning.
must_do: identify what each evidence object directly establishes
separate primary from derived/duplicated information
identify what neither proves alone
check whether the relation exists only when independently produced branches are combined
must_not_do: remove a genuine cross-branch coherence proposition merely to eliminate duplicate-looking fields
cases.notes: Exercises RT-ENG-006 and prevents superficial deduplication.
